leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface that defines the required shape for all plugins
Implement a concrete plugin class that satisfies the defined interface
Initialize a plugin registry that stores and manages typed plugin instances
Apply type guards to validate plugin objects at runtime
Integrate the plugin system into a host application with proper type safety
Manipulate the plugin registry to add, remove, and retrieve plugins
Configure the plugin system to support dynamic loading of typed plugins
